title: Simple biochemical features underlie transcriptional activation domain diversity and dynamic, fuzzy binding to Mediator.
authors: Sanborn, Adrian L; Yeh, Benjamin T; Feigerle, Jordan T; Hao, Cynthia V; Townshend, Raphael Jl; Lieberman Aiden, Erez; Dror, Ron O; Kornberg, Roger D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母转录因子激活域与Mediator亚基的动态模糊结合，虽涉及转录因子功能但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，且仅用简单神经网络预测激活域，与课题的TF-DNA互作建模关联有限。
abstract: Gene activator proteins comprise distinct DNA-binding and transcriptional activation domains (ADs). Because few ADs have been described, we tested domains tiling all yeast transcription factors for activation in vivo and identified 150 ADs. By mRNA display, we showed that 73% of ADs bound the Med15 subunit of Mediator, and that binding strength was correlated with activation. AD-Mediator interaction in vitro was unaffected by a large excess of free activator protein, pointing to a dynamic mechanism of interaction. Structural modeling showed that ADs interact with Med15 without shape complementarity ('fuzzy' binding). ADs shared no sequence motifs, but mutagenesis revealed biochemical and structural constraints. Finally, a neural network trained on AD sequences accurately predicted ADs in human proteins and in other yeast proteins, including chromosomal proteins and chromatin remodeling complexes. These findings solve the longstanding enigma of AD structure and function and provide a rationale for their role in biology.
abstract_zh: 基因激活蛋白包含不同的DNA结合域和转录激活域（ADs）。由于已描述的ADs数量有限，我们测试了覆盖所有酵母转录因子的结构域在体内的激活功能，并鉴定出150个ADs。通过mRNA展示技术，我们证明73%的ADs结合了Mediator复合物的Med15亚基，且结合强度与激活程度相关。体外AD-Mediator相互作用不受大量过量游离激活蛋白的影响，表明这是一种动态的相互作用机制。结构建模显示，ADs与Med15的相互作用缺乏形状互补性（“模糊”结合）。ADs没有共享的序列基序，但突变分析揭示了生化和结构上的限制。最后，基于AD序列训练的神经网络能准确预测人类蛋白质及其他酵母蛋白质（包括染色体蛋白和染色质重塑复合物）中的ADs。这些发现解决了AD结构和功能的长期谜团，并为其在生物学中的作用提供了理论依据。
